name: edit_context
description: Mutate the current role's message list to reduce token usage. Supports three operations applied in order: drop (remove a range of messages), strip_reasoning (clear reasoning blocks on a range), and replace (overwrite one message's content). Returns the new estimated prompt tokens and message count.

humanDescription.detailed: Mutates the conversation to reduce token usage.

operations.description: Ordered list of operations to apply.

range.description: For drop/strip_reasoning: a two-element [start, end] inclusive range of message indices. Ignored for replace.

index.description: For replace: the message index to overwrite.

content.description: For replace: the new message content.
